title: FUSE Mod Definition
description: Human-readable JSON form of a FUSE map mod. BSON uses the same logical model.

schemaVersion.description: FUSE data schema version. This drives migrations and is separate from modVersion. Use the string form, for example "1.0"; integer 1 remains accepted for v1.0 compatibility.

author.description: Optional author string. Converted legacy packages may leave this blank when the source manifest did not name an author.

mixinto.description: Optional legacy conditional mixinto metadata. FUSE applies this fragment only when its requirements are satisfied, matching RailLoader/Strange Customs conditional mixins.

extensions.description: Namespaced extension data. Use reverse-DNS keys, for example com.example.tool.

target.description: Legacy mixinto target name such as game-graph, progressions, scenery, splineys, horns, whistles, or bells.

sourceFile.description: Legacy source file that produced this FUSE fragment.

id.description: Legacy or FUSE package id that must be installed. A converted package id ending in .FUSE also satisfies the original legacy id.

trackRemovals.description: Exact graph object IDs to remove. For base-game track, use Railroader's raw track graph IDs, not UI labels such as siding, spur, station, or industry names.

nodes.description: TrackNode IDs to remove. Base-game node IDs are usually short alphanumeric graph IDs.

segments.description: TrackSegment IDs to remove exactly as they appear in the graph.

spans.description: TrackSpan IDs to remove exactly as they appear in the graph.

end.description: Which segment end the normalized or distance value is measured from. A/Start points toward the segment end; B/End points toward the segment start. Span endpoint arrows must face each other.

legacyIdentifier.description: Optional legacy turntable identifier used to reproduce existing helper node and roundhouse segment IDs.

spawnPoints.description: Custom player/consist spawn points registered as Railroader Character.SpawnPoint components.

telegraphPoleMovements.description: Offsets existing base-game telegraph pole graph nodes by node index/id. Covers legacy TelegraphPoleMover data without creating a new pole set.

suppressBaseScenePaths.description: Base-game scene paths to hide or disable when this package applies.

suppressBaseTrackGroups.description: Base-game track group IDs to suppress when this package applies.

suppressBaseAreas.description: Base-game area IDs to suppress when this package applies.

suppressScenePaths.description: Deprecated alias for suppressBaseScenePaths. FUSE normalizes it on load.

suppressGroups.description: Deprecated alias for suppressBaseTrackGroups. FUSE normalizes it on load.

suppressAreas.description: Deprecated alias for suppressBaseAreas. FUSE normalizes it on load.

worldRemovals.description: Scene-path or FUSE-id removals for world objects. Use this to carry source JSON null entries through conversion.

model.description: Deprecated v1.0 compatibility field. If assetIdentifier is missing, FUSE treats model as the asset identifier and logs one deprecation warning per package.

anchorSpanIds.description: Optional track spans used as anchors. FUSE positions the scenery at the average span center, aligns it to the average span tangent, then applies position/rotation as offsets.

falloff.description: Blend distance at mask edge. Defaults to 0.

enableSetHeight.description: Flatten terrain to a fixed height. Defaults to false.

enableCutTrees.description: Clear trees within mask. Defaults to true.

enableMaskModifier.description: Activate mask modifier. Defaults to true.

order.description: Evaluation order among masks. Defaults to 0.

falloff.description: Blend distance at mask edge. Defaults to 0.

enableSetHeight.description: Flatten terrain to a fixed height. Defaults to false.

enableCutTrees.description: Clear trees within mask. Defaults to true.

enableMaskModifier.description: Activate mask modifier. Defaults to true.

order.description: Evaluation order among masks. Defaults to 0.

falloff.description: Blend distance at mask edge. Defaults to 0.

enableSetHeight.description: Flatten terrain to a fixed height. Defaults to false.

enableCutTrees.description: Clear trees within mask. Defaults to true.

enableMaskModifier.description: Activate mask modifier. Defaults to true.

order.description: Evaluation order among masks. Defaults to 0.

directory.description: MapManager.directoryName this tile source extends, for example BushnellWhittier.

sourceFolder.description: Package-relative folder that contains tile_XXX_YYY.data files. Absolute paths are supported for local migration workflows.

priority.description: Higher-priority sources override lower-priority sources when they provide the same tile coordinate.

clip.description: Path to a loose WAV/MP3/OGG/AIFF file, relative to the FUSE package folder.

progressionId.description: Default runtime Progression.identifier for root sections. If omitted, FUSE uses the package id.

sections.description: Flat authoring form for narrative progression sections. FUSE normalizes these into progressions.<progressionId>.sections at load time.

id.description: Required for progression.sections[]; optional when the section is keyed inside progressions.*.sections.

progressionId.description: Optional override for root sections. Defaults to progression.progressionId or the package id.

prerequisiteSections.description: Alias for prerequisiteSectionIds; preferred for new root section authoring.

prerequisiteSectionIds.description: Legacy keyed-section prerequisite field. FUSE also accepts prerequisiteSections.

unlockIncludeIndustries.description: Section-level unlock payload. FUSE materializes this through a synthetic MapFeature enabled when the section unlocks.

unlockExcludeIndustries.description: Section-level unlock payload. FUSE materializes this through a synthetic MapFeature enabled when the section unlocks.

unlockIncludeIndustryComponents.description: Section-level unlock payload. FUSE materializes this through a synthetic MapFeature enabled when the section unlocks.

areasEnableOnUnlock.description: Section-level unlock payload. FUSE materializes this through a synthetic MapFeature enabled when the section unlocks.

gameObjectsEnableOnUnlock.description: Scene paths to enable when this section unlocks.

trackGroupsEnableOnUnlock.description: Track groups to enable when this section unlocks.

trackGroupsAvailableOnUnlock.description: Track groups to mark available when this section unlocks.

interchangeTransfers.description: Maps a source Interchange industry component id to a destination Interchange component id. Null or blank targets are preserved as no-op legacy entries.

industryComponentId.description: ProgressionIndustryComponent to activate while this delivery phase is pending. Required when deliveries is not empty.

groupIds.description: Compatibility shortcut. If explicit trackGroups* arrays are absent, this fills both enable and available group arrays.
